svg.aria-label: Caper architecture: clients reach a Rust API, WebSocket gateway and web server on AWS through Cloudflare Tunnel; voice audio flows through Cloudflare's Realtime SFU, files through R2 and the CDN Worker, and data lives in PlanetScale Postgres with Valkey for fanout.
svg.text: Control traffic runs on AWS. Voice audio, files and link previews stay on Cloudflare.
